## Actual experiment
Unlike uniform closing/smoothing Run392, test continuous spatially varying SDF smoothing to remove adult wing relief while protecting the face and feet. Voxelize native mesh at .009 pitch, pad 10, spherical closing radius 3, fill, largest connected component, signed distance inside-minus-outside. Smooth base sigma 1 and blend with regional sigma 5 or 8. Region mask using logistic functions s(x)=1/(1+exp(-x)): body=s((.18-Y)/.045)*s((Y+.35)/.035); face=s((Y-.03)/.04)*s((Z-.14)/.05); back=s((.08-Z)/.09); weight=clip((body*(.58+.42*back)+.30*back*(1-body))*(1-face),0,1). Marching cubes at zero; transfer color by inverse-square weighted nearest 6 donor vertices (distance offset .004). On body only, mix cream RGB225,207,183 by t=(.30+.27*rear)*b where b=s((.14-y)/.05)*s((y+.35)/.05), rear=s((.02-z)/.1). Shorten posterior by adding warp*max(0,-z)*b to z, broaden x by 1+.09*b and raise y by .045*b*rear. warp .12/.26 for two variants. Export real GLB and reload. VTK actual renders five angles 0/45/90/135/180 per model at 360x360, orthographic scale .60.
